class_coverage_note: Before FY2001 SBA left NaicsCode blank on whole industries (hotels, restaurants and gas stations are close to zero in FY1991 to FY1997), so a class figure for the window "all" or for an approval year before 2001 undercounts. scripts/markets.py refuses one unless the marker sets allow_flag and the page says so. "all" (every loan) and the windows from FY2016 are unaffected. From FY2001 on, blank codes stay under 1% of rows except in 504 FY2013 2.7%, 504 FY2014 1.6%, where by-year class values undercount by about that share.
classes_note: Classes are not mutually exclusive (a loan coded 721110 counts under every hotel class); never sum across classes. "all" is every loan.
label: Gross approval, net of cancellations
